statement:
(f : ℝ → ℝ) {a b} (hab : a < b) {n k} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hk : k ≠ 0) {ε δ} (hε : ε > 0) (hδ : δ > 0)
  (hunif : ∀ x, x ∈ Set.Icc a b → ∀ y, y ∈ Set.Icc a b → |y - x| < δ → |f y - f x| < ε) (hfine : 2 * (b - a) / ↑n < δ) :
  |RiemannSum f a b (n * k) - RiemannSum f a b n| < (b - a) * ε
name: RiemannSumRefinement
content:
If a function `f` is uniformly continuous on `[a,b]`, then the Riemann sum at `n * k` differs
from that at `n` by at most `(b - a) * ε`, provided the partition is fine enough.
